versos.grego: Τότε οὖν ἔλαβεν ὁ Πειλᾶτος τὸν Ἰησοῦν καὶ ἐμαστίγωσεν.

controles.web: So Pilate then took Jesus, and flogged him.
controles.kjv: Then Pilate therefore took Jesus, and scourged him.
controles.livre: Então Pilatos tomou a Jesus, e o açoitou.

versos.grego: καὶ οἱ στρατιῶται πλέξαντες στέφανον ἐξ ἀκανθῶν ἐπέθηκαν αὐτοῦ τῇ κεφαλῇ, καὶ ἱμάτιον πορφυροῦν περιέβαλον αὐτόν,

controles.web: The soldiers twisted thorns into a crown, and put it on his head, and dressed him in a purple garment.
controles.kjv: And the soldiers platted a crown of thorns, and put it on his head, and they put on him a purple robe,
controles.livre: E trançando os soldados uma coroa de espinhos, puseram-na sobre sua cabeça, e o vestiram de uma roupa vermelha.

versos.grego: καὶ ἤρχοντο πρὸς αὐτὸν καὶ ἔλεγον Χαῖρε ὁ Βασιλεὺς τῶν Ἰουδαίων· καὶ ἐδίδοσαν αὐτῷ ῥαπίσματα.

controles.web: They kept saying, “Hail, King of the Jews!” and they kept slapping him.
controles.kjv: And said, Hail, King of the Jews! and they smote him with their hands.
controles.livre: E diziam: Tenhas alegria, Rei dos Judeus! E davam-lhe bofetadas.

versos.grego: Καὶ ἐξῆλθεν πάλιν ἔξω ὁ Πειλᾶτος καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς Ἴδε ἄγω ὑμῖν αὐτὸν ἔξω, ἵνα γνῶτε ὅτι οὐδεμίαν αἰτίαν εὑρίσκω ἐν αὐτῷ.

controles.web: Then Pilate went out again, and said to them, “Behold, I bring him out to you, that you may know that I find no basis for a charge against him.”
controles.kjv: Pilate therefore went forth again, and saith unto them, Behold, I bring him forth to you, that ye may know that I find no fault in him.
controles.livre: Saiu pois Pilatos outra vez fora, e disse-lhes: Eis que eu o trago para fora até vós, para que saibais que nenhum crime acho nele.

versos.grego: ἐξῆλθεν οὖν ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἔξω, φορῶν τὸν ἀκάνθινον στέφανον καὶ τὸ πορφυροῦν ἱμάτιον. καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς Ἰδοὺ ὁ ἄνθρωπος.

controles.web: Jesus therefore came out, wearing the crown of thorns and the purple garment. Pilate said to them, “Behold, the man!”
controles.kjv: Then came Jesus forth, wearing the crown of thorns, and the purple robe. And Pilate saith unto them, Behold the man!
controles.livre: Jesus foi pois trazido para fora, levando a coroa de espinhos, e a roupa vermelha-roxa. E Pilatos disse-lhes: Eis aqui o homem.

versos.grego: ὅτε οὖν εἶδον αὐτὸν οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ οἱ ὑπηρέται, ἐκραύγασαν λέγοντες Σταύρωσον σταύρωσον. λέγει αὐτοῖς ὁ Πειλᾶτος Λάβετε αὐτὸν ὑμεῖς καὶ σταυρώσατε· ἐγὼ γὰρ οὐχ εὑρίσκω ἐν αὐτῷ αἰτίαν.

controles.web: When therefore the chief priests and the officers saw him, they shouted, saying, “Crucify! Crucify!”   Pilate said to them, “Take him yourselves, and crucify him, for I find no basis for a charge against him.”
controles.kjv: When the chief priests therefore and officers saw him, they cried out, saying, Crucify him, crucify him. Pilate saith unto them, Take ye him, and crucify him: for I find no fault in him.
controles.livre: Quando então os chefes dos sacerdotes e os trabalhadores o viram, eles clamaram, dizendo: Crucifica -o ! Crucifica -o ! Disse-lhes Pilatos: Tomai-o vós, e crucificai -o ; porque eu nenhum crime acho nele.

versos.grego: ἀπεκρίθησαν αὐτῷ οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι Ἡμεῖς νόμον ἔχομεν, καὶ κατὰ τὸν νόμον ὀφείλει ἀποθανεῖν, ὅτι Υἱὸν Θεοῦ ἑαυτὸν ἐποίησεν.

controles.web: The Jews answered him, “We have a law, and by our law he ought to die, because he made himself the Son of God.”
controles.kjv: The Jews answered him, We have a law, and by our law he ought to die, because he made himself the Son of God.
controles.livre: Responderam-lhe os Judeus: Nós temos Lei, e segundo nossa Lei ele deve morrer, porque se fez Filho de Deus.

versos.grego: Ὅτε οὖν ἤκουσεν ὁ Πειλᾶτος τοῦτον τὸν λόγον, μᾶλλον ἐφοβήθη,

controles.web: When therefore Pilate heard this saying, he was more afraid.
controles.kjv: When Pilate therefore heard that saying, he was the more afraid;
controles.livre: Quando pois Pilatos ouviu esta palavra, ficou mais atemorizado.

versos.grego: καὶ εἰσῆλθεν εἰς τὸ πραιτώριον πάλιν καὶ λέγει τῷ Ἰησοῦ Πόθεν εἶ σύ; ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς ἀπόκρισιν οὐκ ἔδωκεν αὐτῷ.

controles.web: He entered into the Praetorium again, and said to Jesus, “Where are you from?” But Jesus gave him no answer.
controles.kjv: And went again into the judgment hall, and saith unto Jesus, Whence art thou? But Jesus gave him no answer.
controles.livre: E entrou outra vez no tribunal, e disse a Jesus: De onde és tu? Mas Jesus não lhe deu resposta.

versos.grego: λέγει οὖν αὐτῷ ὁ Πειλᾶτος Ἐμοὶ οὐ λαλεῖς; οὐκ οἶδας ὅτι ἐξουσίαν ἔχω ἀπολῦσαί σε καὶ ἐξουσίαν ἔχω σταυρῶσαί σε;

controles.web: Pilate therefore said to him, “Aren’t you speaking to me? Don’t you know that I have power to release you, and have power to crucify you?”
controles.kjv: Then saith Pilate unto him, Speakest thou not unto me? knowest thou not that I have power to crucify thee, and have power to release thee?
controles.livre: Disse-lhe pois Pilatos: Não falas comigo? Não sabes que tenho poder para te crucificar, e tenho poder para te soltar?

versos.grego: ἀπεκρίθη Ἰησοῦς Οὐκ εἶχες ἐξουσίαν κατ’ ἐμοῦ οὐδεμίαν εἰ μὴ ἦν δεδομένον σοι ἄνωθεν· διὰ τοῦτο ὁ παραδούς μέ σοι μείζονα ἁμαρτίαν ἔχει.

controles.web: Jesus answered, “You would have no power at all against me, unless it were given to you from above. Therefore he who delivered me to you has greater sin.”
controles.kjv: Jesus answered, Thou couldest have no power at all against me, except it were given thee from above: therefore he that delivered me unto thee hath the greater sin.
controles.livre: Respondeu Jesus: Nenhum poder terias contra mim, se não te fosse dado de cima; portanto o que me entregou a ti tem maior pecado.

versos.grego: ἐκ τούτου ὁ Πειλᾶτος ἐζήτει ἀπολῦσαι αὐτόν· οἱ δὲ Ἰουδαῖοι ἐκραύγασαν λέγοντες Ἐὰν τοῦτον ἀπολύσῃς, οὐκ εἶ φίλος τοῦ Καίσαρος· πᾶς ὁ βασιλέα ἑαυτὸν ποιῶν ἀντιλέγει τῷ Καίσαρι.

controles.web: At this, Pilate was seeking to release him, but the Jews cried out, saying, “If you release this man, you aren’t Caesar’s friend! Everyone who makes himself a king speaks against Caesar!”
controles.kjv: And from thenceforth Pilate sought to release him: but the Jews cried out, saying, If thou let this man go, thou art not Cesar’s friend: whosoever maketh himself a king speaketh against Cesar.
controles.livre: Desde então Pilatos procurava soltá-lo; mas os Judeus clamavam, dizendo: Se soltas a este, não és amigo de César; qualquer que se faz Rei, contradiz a César.

versos.grego: Ὁ οὖν Πειλᾶτος ἀκούσας τῶν λόγων τούτων ἤγαγεν ἔξω τὸν Ἰησοῦν, καὶ ἐκάθισεν ἐπὶ βήματος εἰς τόπον λεγόμενον Λιθόστρωτον, Ἑβραϊστὶ δὲ Γαββαθα.

controles.web: When Pilate therefore heard these words, he brought Jesus out, and sat down on the judgment seat at a place called “The Pavement”, but in Hebrew, “Gabbatha.”
controles.kjv: When Pilate therefore heard that saying, he brought Jesus forth, and sat down in the judgment seat in a place that is called the Pavement, but in the Hebrew, Gabbatha.
controles.livre: Então Pilatos, ouvindo este dito, levou fora a Jesus, e sentou-se no tribunal, no lugar chamado Litóstrotos, ou pavimento ,e em hebraico Gabatá.

versos.grego: ἦν δὲ Παρασκευὴ τοῦ πάσχα, ὥρα ἦν ὡς ἕκτη· καὶ λέγει τοῖς Ἰουδαίοις Ἴδε ὁ Βασιλεὺς ὑμῶν.

controles.web: Now it was the Preparation Day of the Passover, at about the sixth hour. He said to the Jews, “Behold, your King!”
controles.kjv: And it was the preparation of the passover, and about the sixth hour: and he saith unto the Jews, Behold your King!
controles.livre: E era a preparação da páscoa, e quase à hora sexta, e disse aos Judeus: Eis aqui vosso Rei!

versos.grego: ἐκραύγασαν οὖν ἐκεῖνοι Ἆρον ἆρον, σταύρωσον αὐτόν. λέγει αὐτοῖς ὁ Πειλᾶτος Τὸν Βασιλέα ὑμῶν σταυρώσω; ἀπεκρίθησαν οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς Οὐκ ἔχομεν βασιλέα εἰ μὴ Καίσαρα.

controles.web: They cried out, “Away with him! Away with him! Crucify him!”   Pilate said to them, “Shall I crucify your King?”   The chief priests answered, “We have no king but Caesar!”
controles.kjv: But they cried out, Away with him, away with him, crucify him. Pilate saith unto them, Shall I crucify your King? The chief priests answered, We have no king but Cesar.
controles.livre: Mas eles bradaram: Tira, tira, crucifica-o! Disse-lhes Pilatos: Crucificarei a vosso Rei?Responderam os chefes dos sacerdotes: Não temos outro rei, a não ser César.

versos.grego: τότε οὖν παρέδωκεν αὐτὸν αὐτοῖς ἵνα σταυρωθῇ. Παρέλαβον οὖν τὸν Ἰησοῦν·

controles.web: So then he delivered him to them to be crucified. So they took Jesus and led him away.
controles.kjv: Then delivered he him therefore unto them to be crucified. And they took Jesus, and led him away.
controles.livre: Então o entregou a eles, para que fosse crucificado. E tomaram a Jesus, e levaram -no .

versos.grego: καὶ βαστάζων ἑαυτῷ τὸν σταυρὸν ἐξῆλθεν εἰς τὸν λεγόμενον Κρανίου τόπον, ὃ λέγεται Ἑβραϊστὶ Γολγοθᾶ,

controles.web: He went out, bearing his cross, to the place called “The Place of a Skull”, which is called in Hebrew, “Golgotha”,
controles.kjv: And he bearing his cross went forth into a place called the place of a skull, which is called in the Hebrew Golgotha:
controles.livre: E levando ele sua cruz, saiu para o lugar chamado a Caveira, que em hebraico se chama Gólgota.

versos.grego: ὅπου αὐτὸν ἐσταύρωσαν, καὶ μετ’ αὐτοῦ ἄλλους δύο ἐντεῦθεν καὶ ἐντεῦθεν, μέσον δὲ τὸν Ἰησοῦν.

controles.web: where they crucified him, and with him two others, on either side one, and Jesus in the middle.
controles.kjv: Where they crucified him, and two other with him, on either side one, and Jesus in the midst.
controles.livre: Onde o crucificaram, e com ele outros dois, um de cada lado, e a Jesus no meio.

versos.grego: ἔγραψεν δὲ καὶ τίτλον ὁ Πειλᾶτος καὶ ἔθηκεν ἐπὶ τοῦ σταυροῦ· ἦν δὲ γεγραμμένον ΙΗΣΟΥΣ Ο ΝΑΖΩΡΑΙΟΣ Ο ΒΑΣΙΛΕΥΣ ΤΩΝ ΙΟΥΔΑΙΩΝ.

controles.web: Pilate wrote a title also, and put it on the cross. There was written, “JESUS OF NAZARETH, THE KING OF THE JEWS.”
controles.kjv: And Pilate wrote a title, and put it on the cross. And the writing was, JESUS OF NAZARETH THE KING OF THE JEWS.
controles.livre: E Pilatos também escreveu um título, e o pôs encima da cruz, e estava nele escrito: JESUS NAZARENO, REI DOS JUDEUS.

versos.grego: τοῦτον οὖν τὸν τίτλον πολλοὶ ἀνέγνωσαν τῶν Ἰουδαίων, ὅτι ἐγγὺς ἦν ὁ τόπος τῆς πόλεως ὅπου ἐσταυρώθη ὁ Ἰησοῦς· καὶ ἦν γεγραμμένον Ἑβραϊστί, Ῥωμαϊστί, Ἑλληνιστί.

controles.web: Therefore many of the Jews read this title, for the place where Jesus was crucified was near the city; and it was written in Hebrew, in Latin, and in Greek.
controles.kjv: This title then read many of the Jews: for the place where Jesus was crucified was nigh to the city: and it was written in Hebrew, and Greek, and Latin.
controles.livre: Leram pois muitos dos Judeus este título; porque o lugar onde Jesus estava crucificado era perto da cidade; e estava escrito em hebraico, em grego, e em latim.

versos.grego: ἔλεγον οὖν τῷ Πειλάτῳ οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς τῶν Ἰουδαίων Μὴ γράφε Ὁ Βασιλεὺς τῶν Ἰουδαίων, ἀλλ’ ὅτι ἐκεῖνος εἶπεν Βασιλεύς εἰμι τῶν Ἰουδαίων.

controles.web: The chief priests of the Jews therefore said to Pilate, “Don’t write, ‘The King of the Jews,’ but, ‘he said, I am King of the Jews.’”
controles.kjv: Then said the chief priests of the Jews to Pilate, Write not, The King of the Jews; but that he said, I am King of the Jews.
controles.livre: Diziam pois os chefes dos sacerdotes dos judeus a Pilatos: Não escrevas: Rei dos Judeus, mas que disse: Sou Rei dos Judeus.

versos.grego: ἀπεκρίθη ὁ Πειλᾶτος Ὃ γέγραφα, γέγραφα.

controles.web: Pilate answered, “What I have written, I have written.”
controles.kjv: Pilate answered, What I have written I have written.
controles.livre: Respondeu Pilatos: O que escrevi, escrevi.

versos.grego: Οἱ οὖν στρατιῶται, ὅτε ἐσταύρωσαν τὸν Ἰησοῦν, ἔλαβον τὰ ἱμάτια αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐποίησαν τέσσερα μέρη, ἑκάστῳ στρατιώτῃ μέρος, καὶ τὸν χιτῶνα. ἦν δὲ ὁ χιτὼν ἄραφος, ἐκ τῶν ἄνωθεν ὑφαντὸς δι’ ὅλου.

controles.web: Then the soldiers, when they had crucified Jesus, took his garments and made four parts, to every soldier a part; and also the coat. Now the coat was without seam, woven from the top throughout.
controles.kjv: Then the soldiers, when they had crucified Jesus, took his garments, and made four parts, to every soldier a part; and also his coat: now the coat was without seam, woven from the top throughout.
controles.livre: Havendo pois os soldados crucificado a Jesus, tomaram suas roupas, e fizeram quatro partes, para cada soldado uma parte, e a túnica. E era a túnica sem costura, toda tecida desde cima até baixo .

versos.grego: εἶπαν οὖν πρὸς ἀλλήλους Μὴ σχίσωμεν αὐτόν, ἀλλὰ λάχωμεν περὶ αὐτοῦ τίνος ἔσται· ἵνα ἡ γραφὴ πληρωθῇ Διεμερίσαντο τὰ ἱμάτιά μου ἑαυτοῖς καὶ ἐπὶ τὸν ἱματισμόν μου ἔβαλον κλῆρον. Οἱ μὲν οὖν στρατιῶται ταῦτα ἐποίησαν.

controles.web: Then they said to one another, “Let’s not tear it, but cast lots for it to decide whose it will be,” that the Scripture might be fulfilled, which says,  “They parted my garments among them. For my cloak they cast lots.”    Therefore the soldiers did these things.
controles.kjv: They said therefore among themselves, Let us not rend it, but cast lots for it, whose it shall be: that the scripture might be fulfilled, which saith, They parted my raiment among them, and for my vesture they did cast lots. These things therefore the soldiers did.
controles.livre: Disseram pois uns aos outros: Não a partamos, mas lancemos sortes sobre ela, de quem será; para que se cumprisse a Escritura, que diz: Entre si partiram minhas roupas, e sobre minha veste lançaram sortes. Os soldados, pois, fizeram isto.

versos.grego: εἱστήκεισαν δὲ παρὰ τῷ σταυρῷ τοῦ Ἰησοῦ ἡ μήτηρ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἡ ἀδελφὴ τῆς μητρὸς αὐτοῦ, Μαρία ἡ τοῦ Κλωπᾶ καὶ Μαρία ἡ Μαγδαληνή.

controles.web: But there were standing by the cross of Jesus his mother, and his mother’s sister, Mary the wife of Clopas, and Mary Magdalene.
controles.kjv: Now there stood by the cross of Jesus his mother, and his mother’s sister, Mary the wife of Cleophas, and Mary Magdalene.
controles.livre: E estavam junto à cruz de Jesus, sua mãe, e a irmã de sua mãe, Maria mulher de Cleofas, e Maria Madalena.

versos.grego: Ἰησοῦς οὖν ἰδὼν τὴν μητέρα καὶ τὸν μαθητὴν παρεστῶτα ὃν ἠγάπα, λέγει τῇ μητρί Γύναι, ἴδε ὁ υἱός σου.

controles.web: Therefore when Jesus saw his mother, and the disciple whom he loved standing there, he said to his mother, “Woman, behold your son!”
controles.kjv: When Jesus therefore saw his mother, and the disciple standing by, whom he loved, he saith unto his mother, Woman, behold thy son!
controles.livre: E vendo Jesus a sua mãe, e ao discípulo a quem amava, que ali estava, disse a sua mãe: Mulher, eis aí teu filho.

versos.grego: εἶτα λέγει τῷ μαθητῇ Ἴδε ἡ μήτηρ σου. καὶ ἀπ’ ἐκείνης τῆς ὥρας ἔλαβεν ὁ μαθητὴς αὐτὴν εἰς τὰ ἴδια.

controles.web: Then he said to the disciple, “Behold, your mother!” From that hour, the disciple took her to his own home.
controles.kjv: Then saith he to the disciple, Behold thy mother! And from that hour that disciple took her unto his own home.
controles.livre: Depois disse ao discípulo: Eis aí tua mãe. E desde aquela hora o discípulo a recebeu em sua casa .

versos.grego: Μετὰ τοῦτο εἰδὼς ὁ Ἰησοῦς ὅτι ἤδη πάντα τετέλεσται, ἵνα τελειωθῇ ἡ γραφὴ, λέγει Διψῶ.

controles.web: After this, Jesus, seeing that all things were now finished, that the Scripture might be fulfilled, said, “I am thirsty.”
controles.kjv: After this, Jesus knowing that all things were now accomplished, that the scripture might be fulfilled, saith, I thirst.
controles.livre: Depois disto, sabendo Jesus que já todas as coisas estavam feitas, para que a Escritura se cumprisse, ele disse: Tenho sede.

versos.grego: σκεῦος ἔκειτο ὄξους μεστόν· σπόγγον οὖν μεστὸν τοῦ ὄξους ὑσσώπῳ περιθέντες προσήνεγκαν αὐτοῦ τῷ στόματι.

controles.web: Now a vessel full of vinegar was set there; so they put a sponge full of the vinegar on hyssop, and held it at his mouth.
controles.kjv: Now there was set a vessel full of vinegar: and they filled a spunge with vinegar, and put it upon hyssop, and put it to his mouth.
controles.livre: Estava pois ali um vaso cheio de vinagre, e encheram uma esponja de vinagre, e envolvendo-a com hissopo, levaram-na a sua boca.

versos.grego: ὅτε οὖν ἔλαβεν τὸ ὄξος ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν Τετέλεσται, καὶ κλίνας τὴν κεφαλὴν παρέδωκεν τὸ πνεῦμα.

controles.web: When Jesus therefore had received the vinegar, he said, “It is finished.” He bowed his head, and gave up his spirit.
controles.kjv: When Jesus therefore had received the vinegar, he said, It is finished: and he bowed his head, and gave up the ghost.
controles.livre: Quando pois Jesus tomou o vinagre, disse: Está consumado; e abaixando a cabeça, deu o Espírito.

versos.grego: Οἱ οὖν Ἰουδαῖοι, ἐπεὶ Παρασκευὴ ἦν, ἵνα μὴ μείνῃ ἐπὶ τοῦ σταυροῦ τὰ σώματα ἐν τῷ σαββάτῳ, ἦν γὰρ μεγάλη ἡ ἡμέρα ἐκείνου τοῦ σαββάτου, ἠρώτησαν τὸν Πειλᾶτον ἵνα κατεαγῶσιν αὐτῶν τὰ σκέλη καὶ ἀρθῶσιν.

controles.web: Therefore the Jews, because it was the Preparation Day, so that the bodies wouldn’t remain on the cross on the Sabbath (for that Sabbath was a special one), asked of Pilate that their legs might be broken, and that they might be taken away.
controles.kjv: The Jews therefore, because it was the preparation, that the bodies should not remain upon the cross on the sabbath day, (for that sabbath day was an high day,) besought Pilate that their legs might be broken, and that they might be taken away.
controles.livre: Os Judeus pois, para que os corpos não ficassem no sábado na cruz, pois era a preparação (porque era o grande dia do Sábado), suplicaram a Pilatos que as pernas deles fossem quebradas, e fossem tirados.

versos.grego: ἦλθον οὖν οἱ στρατιῶται, καὶ τοῦ μὲν πρώτου κατέαξαν τὰ σκέλη καὶ τοῦ ἄλλου τοῦ συνσταυρωθέντος αὐτῷ·

controles.web: Therefore the soldiers came, and broke the legs of the first, and of the other who was crucified with him;
controles.kjv: Then came the soldiers, and brake the legs of the first, and of the other which was crucified with him.
controles.livre: Vieram pois os soldados, e na verdade quebraram as pernas do primeiro, e do outro, que fora crucificado com ele.

versos.grego: ἐπὶ δὲ τὸν Ἰησοῦν ἐλθόντες, ὡς εἶδον ἤδη αὐτὸν τεθνηκότα, οὐ κατέαξαν αὐτοῦ τὰ σκέλη,

controles.web: but when they came to Jesus, and saw that he was already dead, they didn’t break his legs.
controles.kjv: But when they came to Jesus, and saw that he was dead already, they brake not his legs:
controles.livre: Mas vindo a Jesus, e vendo-o já morto, não quebraram as suas pernas.

versos.grego: ἀλλ’ εἷς τῶν στρατιωτῶν λόγχῃ αὐτοῦ τὴν πλευρὰν ἔνυξεν, καὶ ἐξῆλθεν εὐθὺς αἷμα καὶ ὕδωρ.

controles.web: However one of the soldiers pierced his side with a spear, and immediately blood and water came out.
controles.kjv: But one of the soldiers with a spear pierced his side, and forthwith came there out blood and water.
controles.livre: Mas um dos soldados lhe furou com uma lança o lado, e logo saiu sangue e água.

versos.grego: καὶ ὁ ἑωρακὼς μεμαρτύρηκεν, καὶ ἀληθινὴ αὐτοῦ ἐστιν ἡ μαρτυρία, καὶ ἐκεῖνος οἶδεν ὅτι ἀληθῆ λέγει, ἵνα καὶ ὑμεῖς πιστεύητε.

controles.web: He who has seen has testified, and his testimony is true. He knows that he tells the truth, that you may believe.
controles.kjv: And he that saw it bare record, and his record is true: and he knoweth that he saith true, that ye might believe.
controles.livre: E o que viu isto, o testemunhou; e seu testemunho é verdadeiro, e sabe que é verdade o que diz, para que vós também creiais.

versos.grego: ἐγένετο γὰρ ταῦτα ἵνα ἡ γραφὴ πληρωθῇ Ὀστοῦν οὐ συντριβήσεται αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: For these things happened, that the Scripture might be fulfilled, “A bone of him will not be broken.”
controles.kjv: For these things were done, that the scripture should be fulfilled, A bone of him shall not be broken.
controles.livre: Porque estas coisas aconteceram para que se cumprisse a Escritura que diz : Osso dele não será quebrado.

versos.grego: καὶ πάλιν ἑτέρα γραφὴ λέγει Ὄψονται εἰς ὃν ἐξεκέντησαν.

controles.web: Again another Scripture says, “They will look on him whom they pierced.”
controles.kjv: And again another scripture saith, They shall look on him whom they pierced.
controles.livre: E além disso, outra Escritura diz: Verão aquele a quem perfuraram.

versos.grego: Μετὰ δὲ ταῦτα ἠρώτησεν τὸν Πειλᾶτον Ἰωσὴφ ἀπὸ Ἁριμαθαίας, ὢν μαθητὴς τοῦ Ἰησοῦ κεκρυμμένος δὲ διὰ τὸν φόβον τῶν Ἰουδαίων, ἵνα ἄρῃ τὸ σῶμα τοῦ Ἰησοῦ· καὶ ἐπέτρεψεν ὁ Πειλᾶτος. ἦλθεν οὖν καὶ ἦρεν τὸ σῶμα αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: After these things, Joseph of Arimathaea, being a disciple of Jesus, but secretly for fear of the Jews, asked of Pilate that he might take away Jesus’ body. Pilate gave him permission. He came therefore and took away his body.
controles.kjv: And after this Joseph of Arimathea, being a disciple of Jesus, but secretly for fear of the Jews, besought Pilate that he might take away the body of Jesus: and Pilate gave him leave. He came therefore, and took the body of Jesus.
controles.livre: E depois José de Arimateia, (que era discípulo de Jesus, porém oculto por medo dos Judeus) suplicou a Pilatos que pudesse tirar o corpo de Jesus; e Pilatos permitiu. Veio pois e tirou o corpo de Jesus.

versos.grego: ἦλθεν δὲ καὶ Νικόδημος, ὁ ἐλθὼν πρὸς αὐτὸν νυκτὸς τὸ πρῶτον, φέρων μίγμα σμύρνης καὶ ἀλόης ὡς λίτρας ἑκατόν.

controles.web: Nicodemus, who at first came to Jesus by night, also came bringing a mixture of myrrh and aloes, about a hundred Roman pounds.
controles.kjv: And there came also Nicodemus, which at the first came to Jesus by night, and brought a mixture of myrrh and aloes, about an hundred pound weight.
controles.livre: E veio também Nicodemos, (aquele que antes de noite tinha vindo a Jesus) trazendo um composto de mirra e aloés, de quase cem arráteis.

versos.grego: ἔλαβον οὖν τὸ σῶμα τοῦ Ἰησοῦ καὶ ἔδησαν αὐτὸ ὀθονίοις μετὰ τῶν ἀρωμάτων, καθὼς ἔθος ἐστὶν τοῖς Ἰουδαίοις ἐνταφιάζειν.

controles.web: So they took Jesus’ body, and bound it in linen cloths with the spices, as the custom of the Jews is to bury.
controles.kjv: Then took they the body of Jesus, and wound it in linen clothes with the spices, as the manner of the Jews is to bury.
controles.livre: Tomaram pois o corpo de Jesus, e o envolveram em lençóis com as especiarias, como é costume dos judeus sepultarem.

versos.grego: ἦν δὲ ἐν τῷ τόπῳ ὅπου ἐσταυρώθη κῆπος, καὶ ἐν τῷ κήπῳ μνημεῖον καινόν, ἐν ᾧ οὐδέπω οὐδεὶς ἦν τεθειμένος·

controles.web: Now in the place where he was crucified there was a garden. In the garden was a new tomb in which no man had ever yet been laid.
controles.kjv: Now in the place where he was crucified there was a garden; and in the garden a new sepulchre, wherein was never man yet laid.
controles.livre: E havia um jardim naquele lugar onde fora crucificado; e no jardim havia um sepulcro novo, em que ainda nunca alguém havia sido posto.

versos.grego: ἐκεῖ οὖν διὰ τὴν Παρασκευὴν τῶν Ἰουδαίων, ὅτι ἐγγὺς ἦν τὸ μνημεῖον, ἔθηκαν τὸν Ἰησοῦν.

controles.web: Then because of the Jews’ Preparation Day (for the tomb was near at hand) they laid Jesus there.
controles.kjv: There laid they Jesus therefore because of the Jews’ preparation day; for the sepulchre was nigh at hand.
controles.livre: Ali pois (por causa da preparação da páscoa dos Judeus, e porque aquele sepulcro estava perto) puseram a Jesus.
